prompt:

Asset type: desktop AI redesign concept bitmap for TALKPIK AI user app

Must preserve state signals: My Library saved-answer management, search, bulk action bar, tabs, filters, saved answer row, pagination, right statistics.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, loud gradient, colorful CTA, decorative illustration, over-rounded cards, heavy shadows.
